value.rationale: The sharp edge-BV gain of a canonical checkerboard conditional expectation on all rectangular pixel grids is a complete, natural operator invariant with a parity-sensitive exact formula. Odd-by-odd grids require a nontrivial eight-Hamilton-path capacity construction; all-grid attainment by degree-two corners and the unique 2x2 nonexpansive case show actual shape and stability behavior. This is useful for graph-variation stability of blockwise reconstruction and not merely a routine numerical table.
